workspace.qrcodeAlt: QR code for the profile URL

profileTransformPreview.noTranspiledScript: No saved transpiled transform script is available.

syncError.refreshFailed: A subscription source failed to refresh. Use the error details button on its card.
syncError.truncatedBody: Only the first 64 KiB of the response body is shown.

vlan.title: VLAN

cidr.hint: Press Enter, space or comma to add. Paste several at once; click an entry to edit it.
cidr.invalid: "{{token}}" is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR.

vlan.name: Name

wireGuardImport.title: Import WireGuard configuration
wireGuardImport.portalHint: Paste a single EasyTier client export to fill the Portal endpoint, suggested subnet and AllowedIPs. Supply the Portal server key separately.
wireGuardImport.clientHint: Paste the client configuration assigned to this supplicant. The draft uses its client key and every peer.
wireGuardImport.reviewPortal: Review the Portal subnet and server key, then check the VLAN CIDRs.
wireGuardImport.reviewClient: Client draft updated. Verify that the VLAN CIDRs cover all peer AllowedIPs.
wireGuardImport.wildcard: Replace the Portal wildcard listener with a reachable host.
wireGuardImport.format: Use one [Interface] followed by [Peer] sections. EasyTier Portal import requires one peer.
wireGuardImport.endpoint: Enter a valid endpoint with a hostname or IP address and a port from 1 to 65535.
wireGuardImport.allowedIps: Enter a comma-separated list of valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs.
wireGuardImport.keepalive: Mihomo requires the same PersistentKeepalive setting across all peers.
wireGuardImport.fields: Check the keys and addresses. Supported fields are Address, PrivateKey, MTU, Endpoint, PublicKey, PresharedKey, AllowedIPs and PersistentKeepalive.

vlan.saveError: Could not save VLAN settings. Check tunnel credentials, grants and whether the VLAN CIDRs cover every AllowedIPs entry.
vlan.hint: Use vlans=office,lab:10 in the subscription URL, or append confluence/supplicant=<key>&vlans=office,lab:10 to the User-Agent. Only EasyTier uses slots. Configure the matching age key in your client.
vlan.loadError: Could not load the VLAN catalog.
vlan.inUse: Remove it from every VLAN before deleting.
vlan.deleteNetworkHint: Deleting this VLAN also removes its references from every workspace.
vlan.removeMemberHint: Removing {{name}} also revokes their {{count}} tunnel grant(s).
vlan.enabledHint: Inactive VLANs keep their settings but are left out of subscriptions.
vlan.membersHint: Supplicants allowed to join this VLAN. Grant them access to individual tunnels below.
vlan.noSupplicants: No supplicants yet. Create one in the Supplicants section of the VLAN page first.
vlan.tunnelsHint: How members reach the VLAN. EasyTier Portals hand out addresses by slot; WireGuard tunnels use a client config per member.
vlan.removeTunnelHint: Delete this tunnel, its grants and its stored credentials?
vlan.accessEmpty: Add VLAN members above to grant them access here.
vlan.removeClientConfig: Delete this WireGuard configuration, its credentials and any associated access?
vlan.peersEmpty: No peers yet. Import a client config or add one manually.
vlan.portalDescription: WireGuard Portal served by an EasyTier gateway. Members get addresses by slot.
vlan.wireGuardDescription: Any WireGuard server. Each member gets their own client config.
vlan.routesHint: Traffic to these CIDRs is routed into the VLAN. They must cover every tunnel's AllowedIPs.

blockers.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
blockers.incompleteWireGuard: Every WireGuard configuration needs an address and at least one peer.
blockers.enabledIncomplete: An active VLAN needs at least one tunnel and one CIDR.

vlan.recipientHint: age X25519 public key (age1…), e.g. from age-keygen -y.
vlan.pageDescription: Shared VLANs and the supplicant keys that may join them. Link VLANs to a workspace from its page.
